attributes.name: Grogul
attributes.powers:
At the start of your turn, reveal this card to recharge the ally Snick or the ally Torius Vin from your discard pile.

Recharge this card to add 1d6 and the Swashbuckling trait to your combat check.

Recharge this card to reduce Combat damage dealt to you by 1.

Discard this card to explore your location.
